text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer understand patterns. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess if an email is spam or not. The accuracy of these predictions depends on the quality of the training data and the model. Good data usually leads to better results.
